about_short_description.short_description: ClipDrop is an app that turns regular mobile photos into professional product visuals.

product.name: Cleanup
product.description: An AI tool that removes unwanted objects, people, text, and defects from images automatically.

product.name: Remove Background
product.description: A tool that extracts the main subject from an image by removing its background with high accuracy.

product.name: Image Upscaler
product.description: An AI tool that enlarges images by 2x or 4x while reducing noise and recovering details.

product.name: Reimagine
product.description: A tool that generates multiple variations of an image using AI algorithms.

product.name: Generative Fill
product.description: An AI feature that replaces, removes, or fixes elements within images.

product.name: Universal Resizer
product.description: A tool to resize images for different social media platforms.
